data.name: Idalina
data.gender_notes: Idalina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin words idus (festival) and alina (little shepherdess or tender). In Christianity, Idalina is the name of a 3rd-century martyr and virgin saint. The name Idalina carries the meaning “Little Shepherdess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Idalina usually hope their child will grow to embody little shepherdess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and tenderness towards others.
data.etymology: Idalina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Shepherdess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Idalina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אידלינה
in_hebrew.meaning: אידלינה היא שם שפירושו עבודה אלוהית או שיר חסד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אידלינה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'עבודה אלוהית' או 'שיר חסד'. השם נגזר מהמילה הגרמנית 'adal' שפירושו 'אציל' ו-'linde' שפירושו 'שיר' או 'עבודה'. השם אידלינה הוא שם שמשדר כוח רוחני וקשר לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ιδαλίνη
in_greek.meaning: Ιδαλίνη σημαίνει θείο τραγούδι ή θεϊκή υπηρεσία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιδαλίνη είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'θείο τραγούδι' ή 'θεϊκή υπηρεσία'. Η λέξη προέρχεται από το γερμανικό 'adal' που σημαίνει 'ευγενής' και 'linde' που σημαίνει 'τραγούδι' ή 'υπηρεσία'. Το όνομα Ιδαλίνη είναι ένα όνομα που εκπέμπει πνευματική δύναμη και σύνδεση με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Idalina
in_latin.meaning: Idalina significat canticum divinum seu servitium
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Idalina est nomen christianum quod ex lingua germanica originem habet et significat 'canticum divinum' seu 'servitium'. Verbum derivatur ex germanico 'adal' quod significat 'nobilis' et 'linde' quod significat 'canticum' seu 'servitium'. Nomen Idalina est nomen quod spiritalem virtutem et connexionem cum Deo praemitit.

in_english.name: Idalina
in_english.meaning: Idalina means divine song or noble service
in_english.long_meaning: Idalina is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'divine song' or 'noble service'. It originates from the German words 'adal', meaning 'noble', and 'linde', meaning 'song' or 'service'. The name Idalina conveys spiritual strength and a connection to God, reflecting a deep sense of devotion and worship. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a life of spiritual dedication and service to others.
